blocks.tamil_translation: spent standing is better than worshipping (standing) before the Hajr-e-Aswad on the night of Laylat-ul-Qadr.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ رَهْبَانِيَّةٌ، وَرَهْبَانِيَّةُ هذِهِ اْلأُمَّةِ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ .
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Every Prophet has a monasticism, and the monasticism of my Ummah is striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- Remaining detached from the world and its pleasures is called monasticism.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَثَلُ الْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، وَاللهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ كَمَثَلِ الصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ الْخَاشِعِ الرَّاكِعِ السَّاجِدِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي،باب مثل المجاهد في سبيل الله ، رقم:٣١٢٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “The example of one who strives in the path of Allah Ta'ala (and Allah Ta'ala knows best who it is that strives for the pleasure of Allah) is like one who fasts, stands in worship at night, and, out of the fear of Allah, expresses his helplessness before Allah and performs ruku' and sujud.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَثَلُ الْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، كَمَثَلِ الصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ الْقَانِتِ بِآيَاتِ اللهِ لَا يَفْتُرُ مِنْ
